summary: Edesa Biotech filed a routine Form 8-K Item 8.01 disclosing FDA clearance of its IND for a Phase 2 study of EB06 in vitiligo, expanding recruitment to the United States. The double-blind, placebo-controlled trial randomizes up to 80 adults with moderate-to-severe nonsegmental vitiligo 1:1 to EB06 or placebo every two weeks through Week 22, with primary endpoint mean percent change in F-VASI at Week 28. Canadian recruitment is underway; U.S. sites are expected to enroll next quarter, with topline data anticipated fourth quarter 2027. No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or transactional mechanics are stated.
